intent: The entity engine (packages/entity-engine, landed in v11.15.0) built three excellent but UNWIRED modules: a schema catalog, an omnibox NER parser, and a DPDP PII scanner. This spec wires them into the live product: NER intent resolution inside the admin CommandPalette, PII scan-and-redact enforcement at every content write point with an auditable pii_audit_trails sink, a DPDP risk dashboard, bilingual (Hindi/Devanagari) query understanding, role-scoped omniboxes for the Teacher and Parent PWAs, a corrected route map, and catalog completeness plus sub-5ms performance enforcement in CI. Zero new product surface is invented; the engine becomes infrastructure every existing surface consumes.

meta.stack: Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind dark-mode, lucide-react, drizzle-orm + PostgreSQL with RLS, vitest, cmdk, zod
meta.dependency_policy: NO new npm dependencies. zod (already added in 52892d54) is the only permitted engine dep. cmdk, lucide-react, drizzle-orm, vitest already exist in the workspace.
files_in_scope: teacher PWA route group + components (landed in T3-T10)
parent PWA route group + components (landed in P3-P16)

current_state_audit: packages/entity-engine landed fully in 52892d54 (v11.15.0): src/{catalog,query-ner,dpdp-ner}, __tests__/{catalog,dpdpNER,queryNER}.test.ts, package.json exports ./catalog ./query-ner ./dpdp-ner, scripts/inspect-entity-engine.ts CLI. All tests pass at head.

ENTITY_GRAPH registers 49 tables across 13 domains (CORE_IDENTITY, ACADEMICS, STUDENTS_LIFECYCLE, ADMISSIONS, ATTENDANCE, EXAMINATIONS, FEES_FINANCE, HR_STAFF, TRANSPORT, COMMUNICATION, DPDP_PRIVACY, INVENTORY_FACILITIES, SUPERADMIN_OPS) including all parent/teacher PWA workflow tables (student_leave_requests, ptm_events, ptm_slots, ptm_bookings, fee_queries, notice_acknowledgments, bus_boarding_events, stop_change_requests, student_document_requests, profile_change_requests, teacher_feed_cards) with per-table piiColumns annotations.

catalog/index.ts exposes getEntity, getAllEntities, getEntitiesByDomain, getForeignKeys, getReferencingTables, getPIIColumns, getDomainMetadata, getAllDomainsMetadata, and topologicalSort (Kahn's algorithm with stable cycle append).

query-ner/parser.ts exposes parseOmniboxQuery(rawQuery): ParsedQuery with recognizedEntities (CLASS_SECTION 0.95, EXAM_NAME 0.90, SUBJECT 0.90, FEE_HEAD 0.90, BUS_ROUTE 0.90, DATE_TEMPORAL 0.85, ACTION_INTENT 0.95), overlap-prevented span matching, resolveIntentAndRoute with URLSearchParams composition, confidenceScore, and parseDurationMs. It is deterministic, dependency-free, and client-safe.
dpdp-ner exports verhoeff (Aadhaar checksum), scanner (scanPII with risk classification), redactor (redactPII MASK_PARTIAL / REDACT_FULL).

DEFECT: frontend/src/components/ui/CommandPalette.tsx (at head) imports ONLY searchEverything and cmdk. parseOmniboxQuery is completely unwired from every UI. The engine is dead code from a user perspective.

DEFECT: resolveIntentAndRoute hardcodes routes that DO NOT EXIST in the app: /admin/students, /admin/exams/marks, /admin/exams/results, /admin/fees/dues, /admin/transport/live, /admin/search. The real (admin) route group is /students, /exams, /fees, /transport, /hr, /admissions, /attendance, /communication, /library, /dashboard, /dpdp, /academics, /school, /settings, /profile. Every emitted intent route is a dead link today.

DEFECT: scanPII/redactPII are unwired from every content entry point. A user can paste a student's Aadhaar number, PAN, bank account, or mobile number into a notice body, a parent-teacher message, an exam remark, an assignment description, or a leave reason and it is stored and broadcast verbatim.

DEFECT: there is NO pii_audit_trails table anywhere: not in database/src/schema/dpdp.ts (which has privacyNotices, consentPurposes, consentRecords, rightsRequests, dpdpGrievances, dataBreachLog, vendorRegister, dataRetentionPolicies) and not in ENTITY_GRAPH. The DPDP PII audit sink the engine's risk logging needs does not exist.

DEFECT: query-ner patterns contain zero Hindi/Devanagari aliases (no Devanagari script, no hindi keyword). The product's forms are bilingual (isHindi toggle, titleHi/contentHi columns) but the omnibox understands only English.
DEFECT: parseDurationMs is computed but nothing asserts the <5ms budget; no perf test exists.

DEFECT: catalog coverage is partial: 49 registered tables vs 21 schema files. Missing from ENTITY_GRAPH include vehicles, drivers, gps_pings, student_bus_passes, events, parent_teacher_messages, push_notification_logs, sms_logs, timetable_periods, timetable_slots, curriculum_lessons, student_guardians, staff_designations, staff_salaries, payroll_cycles, payroll_line_items, staff_leaves, hostel tables, book_loans, inventory tables, chart_of_accounts, accounting journal/ledger tables, fee_discounts, fee_waivers, payment_gateway_logs, admission_documents, admission_form_settings, staff_attendance, attendance_notifications, student_fee_advances, superadmin tables.
Teacher and Parent PWAs (fully landed) have no omnibox/search surface at all; only the admin shell has Cmd+K.

behavior: On every keystroke run parseOmniboxQuery locally (synchronous, client-safe, zero network). Do not debounce the NER pass; keep the existing 150ms debounce ONLY for searchEverything.

When confidenceScore >= 0.80 render a pinned INTENT row at the top of the list, visually distinct (primary accent border, intent icon, actionLabel, and entity chips for each recognized entity: e.g. [Class 10-A] [Mathematics] [Marks Entry]).
Enter on the intent row navigates to the resolved route. Cmd+Enter or ArrowDown moves into normal search results.
Below the intent row keep the existing Jump to / Actions groups from searchEverything unchanged.
If confidenceScore < 0.80 show no intent row; pure search behavior as today.
Footer shows parse time in dev builds only (NEXT_PUBLIC debug flag), e.g. 'parsed in 1.4ms'.

registry.VIEW_MARKS: /exams (resolve to the existing exams marks-entry surface; verify exact subpath in codebase and keep grade/section/exam as query params)
registry.SEARCH_GENERAL: no route; the palette's own searchEverything results are the fallback
registry.notes: ACTION_INTENT dictionary entries each carry their own route in metadata; audit every one of them against the real route tree and fix any dead link. Add a unit test that asserts every emitted route for a golden query corpus starts with a route that exists in the app route manifest.

omnibox_admin.accessibility: Intent row is a cmdk Command.Item with value built from actionLabel + entity chips text; keyboard-first, no mouse needed. Dark-mode parity required.

write_point_scan_matrix.critical: BLOCK save; inline AppModal listing detected types and suggesting removal
write_point_scan_matrix.high: ConfirmDialog: 'Send as-is' or 'Mask sensitive values' (applies redactPII MASK_PARTIAL before persist)

write_point_scan_matrix.relaxed: HIGH detected -> warn only (parents legitimately include contact numbers); still audit-log every decision

implementation_rules: Scanning happens in server actions (scanPII server-side only; never ship scanner regexes to the client bundle). Client shows the outcome via the existing ConfirmDialog/AppModal components.

One shared helper scanContentForPII({ schoolId, actorUserId, surface, sourceTable, text }) in a server-only module (e.g. frontend/src/lib/pii/scanEnforcement.ts) that all five write points call. No copy-pasted logic per surface.

CRITICAL = any Verhoeff-valid Aadhaar, PAN, passport, voter id, bank account, IFSC, UPI, or Luhn-valid card. HIGH = Indian mobile or email outside structured contact fields. SPDI mentions (medical, caste, religion) classify MEDIUM.
The masked-send path stores the MASK_PARTIAL output; the audit row stores the decision MASKED plus content_hash of the ORIGINAL input for incident forensics (hash only, never plaintext).

shared_rules: Reuse parseOmniboxQuery unchanged for extraction; role resolvers only map (intent, entities) -> route. Do not fork the parser.
Both resolvers get unit tests with a golden corpus asserting routes match the landed PWA route tree.

additions: Devanagari + romanized Hindi aliases in every dictionary: CLASS_SECTION ('कक्षा 10', 'दसवीं ए', 'dashvi A'), SUBJECT ('गणित', 'विज्ञान', 'हिंदी', 'अंग्रेजी', 'ganit', 'vigyan'), EXAM_NAME ('प्रथम सत्र', 'अर्धवार्षिक', 'वार्षिक परीक्षा', 'unit test'), FEE_HEAD ('फीस', 'ट्यूशन फीस', 'transport vasuli'), BUS_ROUTE ('बस 12', 'रूट 4'), DATE_TEMPORAL ('आज', 'कल', 'इस सप्ताह', 'कल रात'), ACTION_INTENT ('उपस्थिति', 'अंक दर्ज करें', 'फीस जमा', 'रिपोर्ट कार्ड').
Entity chip labels render bilingual: if the active form language is Hindi (existing isHindi pattern), chips show Hindi labels; intent actionLabel gets a labelHi variant in the intent dictionary.
Normalization must fold Devanagari numerals (१० -> 10) before regex matching.
Do not transliterate the whole query; extend dictionaries only. Budget: patterns file stays < 40KB, parse stays < 5ms.

business_logic_rules: BR1: The omnibox intent row appears only at confidenceScore >= 0.80. Lower-confidence parses silently degrade to normal search. No guessing UI.
BR2: Every emitted intent route must exist in the app's real route tree. The ROUTE_REGISTRY is the single source of truth; a test enforces it against a golden corpus.
BR3: PII scanning is server-side only. Scanner code must never appear in a client bundle; add a bundle-hygiene consideration note (client imports only from @schoolmitra/entity-engine/query-ner).
BR4: CRITICAL detection blocks the write. There is no 'send anyway' path for CRITICAL; the only way forward is editing the content.
BR5: HIGH detection offers mask-or-confirm, never silent pass. Masked-send persists redactPII(text, MASK_PARTIAL) output.

BR6: Every scan decision (BLOCKED, MASKED, CONFIRMED_SEND, LOGGED_ONLY) writes exactly one pii_audit_trails row containing types, counts, decision, and a sha-256 content hash. Raw or masked PII is never stored in the audit table.
BR7: pii_audit_trails is append-only. No update or delete code path may exist for it.
BR8: Role omnibox resolvers are scope-enforcing: teacher routes only to teacher's own allocations; parent routes only to own wards. Entity params outside scope resolve to null intent.
BR9: Hindi and English queries must produce identical intents for equivalent inputs (BR verified by golden corpus pairs).
BR10: parseOmniboxQuery p95 duration < 5ms over a 200-query corpus (mixed English/Hindi, 4-40 chars) asserted in vitest; failure fails CI.
BR11: No new npm dependencies; no changes to sw.js caching rules; all tenant reads go through RLS/withTenant patterns; all new modals reuse AppModal/ConfirmDialog.

acceptance_criteria: AC-E1: CommandPalette renders a pinned intent row (actionLabel + entity chips) whenever parseOmniboxQuery confidenceScore >= 0.80; Enter executes it; regular search results remain available below; behavior at <0.80 is identical to today.
AC-E2: Zero dead intent routes: every route emitted by ROUTE_REGISTRY for the golden corpus resolves to an existing app route; unit test enforces it; the /admin/* routes are gone.
AC-E3: query-ner is imported client-side in the palette and runs synchronously; catalog and dpdp-ner are absent from the client bundle.
AC-E4: migration 0051 creates pii_audit_trails with RLS; the table is registered in ENTITY_GRAPH; catalog tests cover it.

AC-E5: a Verhoeff-valid Aadhaar (or PAN/bank/card) in a notice body, message, remark, or assignment description blocks save with an inline modal naming detected types; a random 12-digit number does NOT trigger the block.
AC-E6: a mobile number in a message body opens the mask-or-confirm dialog; masked-send persists MASK_PARTIAL output; both paths write audit rows.
AC-E7: every one of the five write points calls the shared scanContentForPII helper; no duplicated scan logic; leave reasons follow the relaxed HIGH-warn policy and still audit.
AC-E8: the DPDP PII Incidents view lists audit rows with risk/source/decision filters, tenant-scoped, with an EmptyStateCTA when empty.
AC-E9: Hindi queries resolve the same intents as their English equivalents across the golden corpus (Devanagari numerals folded).
AC-E10: teacher PWA omnibox resolves '10-A attendance' and marks/term/substitution intents to the landed T4/T6/T7/T8 surfaces; out-of-scope intents degrade to plain search.
AC-E11: parent PWA omnibox resolves fee/bus/PTM/notice intents to landed P-surfaces, ward-scoped; cross-ward routes are impossible.
AC-E12: catalogCompleteness.test.ts passes with zero orphans in both directions between drizzle schema and ENTITY_GRAPH; inspect CLI --compliance prints 100%.
AC-E13: perf test asserts p95 parseDurationMs < 5ms over the 200-query bilingual corpus; CI fails otherwise.
AC-E14: all new UI is dark-mode complete, reuses AppModal/ConfirmDialog/Combobox/EmptyStateCTA, and adds no npm dependency.
constraints: No new npm dependencies (zod already permitted).
Scanner and redactor run server-side only; client may import only @schoolmitra/entity-engine/query-ner.
pii_audit_trails stores hashes and metadata, never raw or masked PII text.
Do not fork or rewrite parseOmniboxQuery core matching; extend dictionaries and add resolvers.
Preserve sw.js caching rules and offline-first PWA behavior; offline palette degrades gracefully.
All tenant-scoped reads through RLS / withTenant; actor_user_id always from session, never from client input.
Route corrections must not break existing queryNER tests; update them alongside the registry, keeping all previously supported query shapes passing.
Follow the established commit style: feat(entity-engine): ... one phase per commit, tests green per phase.
out_of_scope: No new schema domains, no product features beyond wiring.
No LLM-based NER; the parser stays deterministic rule/dictionary based.
No changes to consent records, rights requests, or breach log tables beyond adding pii_audit_trails.
No admin role changes; no new roles.
Student PWA and other role apps (driver, accountant) get omniboxes in a future spec; this one covers admin shell + teacher + parent only.

definition_of_done: parseOmniboxQuery answers inside every Cmd+K and both role PWA headers in under 5ms in the user's language; every emitted intent lands on a real screen; no Aadhaar, PAN, bank detail, or contact number can leave the school through a notice, message, or remark without being blocked, masked, or audited; the DPDP desk sees every incident; the catalog describes 100% of the database with zero orphans; and all of it is enforced by tests that fail the build, not by documentation.

usage: Save this JSON as docs/entity-engine-spec.json and reference it from AGENTS.md alongside the previous landed specs.
Execute phases E1-E7 strictly in order; each phase is one task boundary with its own commit and green tests. Do not start a phase before the previous one is committed.

Read this spec file fully before editing code. When this spec conflicts with in-repo security constraints (RLS, encryption, DPDP consent, sw.js), the security constraints win; log the conflict in the commit body.
The current_state_audit defects G1-G7 are the grounding: verify each against the repo before fixing; if any is already fixed at read time, skip it and note it in the commit.
Real route subpaths under /exams, /fees, /transport and the teacher/parent PWA route trees must be read from the codebase at implementation time, not assumed from this document.
Spell the IDE name 'Antigravity' in any generated docs.
